But in this case, the action aligns with safety and hygiene. 3. **Superstition vs. Rationality:** - Superstitions are beliefs without evidence. While they’re often harmless, they can lead to irrational behaviors (e.g., avoiding mirrors, wasting resources on "lucky" charms).
